title: A private-Herdr install upgrades across GY-3212 and migrates to the main Herdr
description: Records written by a pre-GY-3212 release for an install on its own Herdr server: the predecessor watch's restart arguments (with --herdr-instance) are accepted, the install moves its launches to the main Herdr workspace, the drained private server is removed, every record drops herdrInstance and the next redeploy passes no --herdr-instance.

steps.name: Upgrade and migrate a private-Herdr install
